findings.comment: Three conflicting open space area figures exist: Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided (vs. 4,709.62 SF required), Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF, and Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided (vs. 4,715 SF required based on 94,293 SF site area). Additionally, site area basis differs (94,192 SF vs 94,293 SF). Cannot determine if minimum 5% requirement is met. Reconcile calculations across all sheets.

Site area basis varies across documents: Sheet 9 uses 94,192 SF; Sheet 35 uses 94,293 SF. This 101 SF difference affects required open space amounts (4,709.62 SF vs. 4,715 SF). Verify controlling site area against legal description and survey; if 94,293 SF is correct, recalculate requirements accordingly.

Open space areas not graphically delineated on landscape plan using H.5 hatching. Legend defines H.5 as Private Common Open Space with grid/square hatch pattern but this pattern is not applied to any areas on the actual drawing. Hatch the required minimum open space with H.5 pattern on landscape plan.

Open space area not labeled with type. Site plan shows only 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of the 11 permitted types applies (landscaped area, plaza, play area, etc.). Revise label to include specific open space type per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

Open space area not dimensioned on site plan. Width, depth, and total area must be shown. Currently only area label is provided with no width or depth dimensions. Add dimension callouts showing length and width (minimum 20 ft each for landscaped area) to verify compliance.

Open space areas not delineated on landscape plan with H.5 legend label. Legend defines H.5 but does not apply marker to open space boundary. Apply H.5 legend marker and hatching/shading to all areas comprising the required open space on landscape plan.

Open space square footage inconsistency between plans: Site Plan drawing shows 4,960 SF; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF provided; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF provided. These differences (up to 1,149 SF) represent significant inconsistencies. Reconcile all figures, confirm controlling calculation basis, and ensure all sheets reference the same final open space area.

Open space percentages and square footages inconsistent across sheets. Site Plan shows 4,960 SF/5%; Site Data Table shows 4,710 SF/5%; Landscape Calculations show 5,859 SF/6.21%. Landscape Plan does not label open space with H.5. Reconcile all sheets to ensure consistent percentages and square footages.

Type of open space not identified on site plan. Labeled only as 'Common Open Space 4,960 sf' without specifying which of 11 permitted types: natural/undeveloped, landscaped area, plaza/patio, play area, educational/cultural/sensory feature, swimming pool, pond, trail, sports court, transit plaza, or combination. Identify specific type(s) claimed per LDC § 2.7.3.A.

Specific amenities within open space areas not clearly identified and described. Landscape plan shows flagstone/cobblestone pattern and trees within courtyard but no callouts or legend labels identify specific amenities (seating, paths, plantings, etc.). Identify and label all amenities included within the open space on site and landscape plans.

Compliance with minimum 20 ft dimension and 650 SF area requirements cannot be verified. Site plan shows 4,960 SF (exceeds 650 SF) but provides no width or depth dimensions. Without specific dimension callouts showing both width and depth meet 20 ft minimum, compliance cannot be confirmed. Add dimension callouts to site plan.

If claimed as landscaped area, cannot verify it exceeds minimum landscaping required by Subchapter C Article 9. Landscape Calculations show multiple landscape categories (Street-Yard, Parking Lot, Private Common Open Space) but breakdown showing which plantings comprise the 5,859 SF private common open space and exceed Article 9 minimums is not clear. Confirm 5,859 SF represents landscaped area exceeding Article 9 requirements.

Cannot verify open space location outside required street yard. Street yard boundary (between ROW and front building wall, extending to outermost corners parallel to street) is not clearly delineated on site or landscape plan. Cannot confirm designated open space falls outside this exclusion zone. Add street yard boundary delineation to site plan.

Cannot confirm open space excludes parking, loading, driveways, or service areas. Site plan shows designated area in central courtyard (suggesting separation from perimeter parking) but lacks clear boundary delineation and dimension callouts to definitively confirm no parking/driveways encroach into open space. Provide clear boundary delineation.

Cannot fully verify open space is compact and contiguous. Central courtyard appears as single area but lacks clear boundary delineation. Discrepancy between 4,960 SF (site plan) and 5,859 SF (landscape calcs) suggests open space may be fragmented into multiple areas. Clarify location and configuration of all open space areas.

Cannot verify open space is readily accessible and useable. While landscape plan shows flagstone pattern and internal sidewalks suggesting courtyard access, site and landscape plans lack clear documentation of pedestrian access routes, entrances, or amenities demonstrating the space is designed for active use and resident accessibility. Provide callouts and access route documentation.
